question: Looking at the green transition score of all the countries and regions over the years, what is the common patterns?
query: <think> Okay, so I'm trying to help someone generate a SQL query for their project. The table they're working with is called 'global_development_indicators' and it's in PostgreSQL. They want to look into the common patterns over the years regarding the green transition score across all countries and regions.  First, I need to understand what exactly they're asking for. They mentioned focusing on the green transition score over time. So, I think they want to see how this score has changed from year to year in different regions or perhaps across the entire dataset without specific regions.  Looking at the table structure provided, there are several fields like 'year', which is an integer, and 'region' as a varchar. The green transition score is one of the float columns listed. So, their query needs to select this column along with the year.  Since they're interested in patterns over time, grouping by year makes sense because each year's data will be aggregated together. This way, they can see trends or changes annually.  They also specified that they only want up to 50 rows in the result set. I remember that PostgreSQL has a LIMIT clause for this, so adding LIMIT 50 at the end of the query should do it.  Putting this all together, the SQL query will select the green transition score and year from the table. Grouping by the year ensures that each unique year's average or sum is taken, which helps in identifying trends over time without having to list every single record beyond 50 rows.  I need to make sure not to include any unnecessary columns because they specifically want only relevant ones based on their question. So, excluding all other fields except 'year' and 'green_transition_score'.  Finally, I'll write the query accordingly, making sure it's correctly formatted with proper SQL syntax for PostgreSQL. </think>  ```sql SELECT year, green_transition_score FROM global_development_indicators WHERE green_transition_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year LIMIT 50; ```
